title: Daily GitHub report
description: Lists the issues and pull requests updated in the last day across your repositories and has Claude group them by what needs action. Appends to reports/github-daily.md in the files folder. Needs a GitHub token saved as a credential named "github" (Explorer > GitHub access does this) and an Anthropic API key saved as a credential named "anthropic" (⋯ > Credentials). Edit REPOS in the first node. Add a schedule under ⋯ > Triggers.
name: Daily GitHub report

config.system: You write a short, plain daily engineering briefing.
config.prompt:
These GitHub issues and pull requests were updated in the last day. Group them under 'Needs action today', 'Waiting on others' and 'FYI'. One line each, keep the repo#number references, no preamble.

{{ $.digest }}

config.source:
def main(input_data):
    return {"text": "Nothing was updated in the last day."}
